metadata.article_title: Application for arrest to state grounds.

article.title: Application for arrest to state grounds.
article.content: Where an application is made for the arrest and detention in prison of the judgment-debtor, it shall state, or be accompanied by an affidavit stating, the grounds on which arrest is applied for.]
article.html:
11AApplication for arrest to state grounds.

Order 21, Rule 11A

Where an application is made for the arrest and detention in prison of the judgment-debtor, it shall state, or be accompanied by an affidavit stating, the grounds on which arrest is applied for.]

2 Ins. by s. 72, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
